title: archidendron bubalinum
intro: Archidendron bubalinum, commonly known as the "Ironwood" or "Bubali", is a species of legume tree in the family Fabaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure, alleviate fever, and treat respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Archidendron bubalinum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Studies have identified the presence of bioactive compounds like isoflavones, phenolic acids, and glycosides in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties.
